variable_coverage.construction: Source definition: Absolute abnormal accruals, |DACC|, measuring abnormal-accrual magnitude. DACC = TA − ETA (Equation (3)); ETA uses Equation (1) coefficient estimates with (ΔREV − ΔREC) (Equation (2)). The paper defines ΔREC as the change in receivables but does not report its scaling; ΔREV is scaled by total assets at t−1. Formula/construction: |DACC_{i,t}| = |TA_{i,t} − ETA_{i,t}|; ETA_{i,t} = β̂_0(1/A_{i,t−1}) + β̂_1(ΔREV_{i,t} − ΔREC_{i,t}) + β̂_2 PPE_{i,t} + β̂_3 ROA_{i,t−1}; β̂ coefficients are estimated in supporting Equation (1).. The baseline dependent variable is a generated result of its frozen supporting fit; the raw requirements above supply the fit inputs.

Source definition: Natural logarithm of the market value of common equity at fiscal year-end; market value is Compustat shares outstanding times closing share price. Formula/construction: ln(CSHO_{i,t} × PRCL_F_{i,t}).

Source definition: Standard deviation of operating cash flow, with each CFO scaled by total assets at the beginning of the fiscal year. Equation (4) states the window t−4 through t, while Table 3 defines it as t−4 through t−1; the paper does not reconcile these incompatible windows. Formula/construction: SD(CFO_{i,s}), s = t−4,...,t; each CFO is scaled by total assets at the beginning of its fiscal year.
Source definition: Operating cash flow scaled by total assets at the beginning of the fiscal year. Formula/construction: OANCF-XIDOC_{i,t} / AT_{i,t−1}.
Source definition: Total long-term debt (Compustat DLTT) scaled by total assets. Formula/construction: DLTT_{i,t} / AT_{i,t}.
Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if net income is below zero and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1[net income_{i,t} < 0]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Market value of equity divided by book value of equity, with book value defined as total assets minus total liabilities (Compustat LT). Formula/construction: market value of equity_{i,t} / (AT_{i,t} − LT_{i,t}).

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 for a high-litigation industry and 0 otherwise. The stated two-digit SIC ranges are 2833–2836, 3570– 3577, 3600–3674, 5200–5961, and 7370–7370 (as printed in the supplied text). Formula/construction: 1[SIC in {2833–2836, 3570–3577, 3600–3674, 5200–5961, 7370–7370}]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Altman’s [1983] score, used as a measure of bankruptcy risk/survival. The paper does not give the score formula or its inputs. Operational formula is not reported in the source or remains ambiguous; preserve that specification gap rather than inventing one.
Source definition: Natural logarithm of the number of years the auditor has audited the firm’s financial statements. Formula/construction: ln(years auditor has audited firm).

Source definition: Absolute value of prior-year total accruals scaled by total assets at the end of year t−1 (the beginning of fiscal year t). Formula/construction: abs(total accruals_{i,t−1} / AT_{i,t−1}).
Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if the company is audited by a Big 4 auditor and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1[Big 4 auditor]; 0 otherwise.
Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 if audited by Grant Thornton or BDO Seidman and 0 otherwise. Formula/construction: 1[Grant Thornton or BDO Seidman auditor]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 for an auditor classified as both national and city specialists under Definition 1, and 0 otherwise. A national (city) specialist has the largest annual audit-fee market share in its two-digit SIC industry and at least a 10-percentage-point lead over the closest competitor in the national (city) market; the city is an MSA. Formula/construction: 1[National Specialist = 1 and City Specialist = 1]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 for an auditor classified as national specialist but not city specialist under Definition 1, and 0 otherwise. A national (city) specialist has the largest annual audit-fee market share in its two-digit SIC industry and at least a 10-percentage-point lead over the closest competitor in the national (city) market; the city is an MSA. Formula/construction: 1[National Specialist = 1 and City Specialist = 0]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Indicator equal to 1 for an auditor classified as city specialist but not national specialist under Definition 1, and 0 otherwise. A national (city) specialist has the largest annual audit-fee market share in its two-digit SIC industry and at least a 10-percentage-point lead over the closest competitor in the national (city) market; the city is an MSA. Formula/construction: 1[National Specialist = 0 and City Specialist = 1]; 0 otherwise.

Source definition: Total accruals for company i in year t: income from continuing operations (Compustat IB) minus operating cash flow (OANCF-XIDOC), divided by total assets (AT) at the end of year t−1. Formula/construction: (IB_{i,t} − OANCF-XIDOC_{i,t}) / AT_{i,t−1}. This is an assigned supporting-model input used to construct a baseline measure; retain its fit and all raw components.

Source definition: Reciprocal of total assets for company i at the end of year t−1. Formula/construction: 1 / AT_{i,t−1}. This is an assigned supporting-model input used to construct a baseline measure; retain its fit and all raw components.

Source definition: Change in revenue (Compustat SALE) from the prior year, divided by total assets at the end of year t−1. Formula/construction: (SALE_{i,t} − SALE_{i,t−1}) / AT_{i,t−1}. This is an assigned supporting-model input used to construct a baseline measure; retain its fit and all raw components.

Source definition: Gross property, plant, and equipment (Compustat PPEGT) for company i at year-end t, divided by total assets at the end of year t−1. Formula/construction: PPEGT_{i,t} / AT_{i,t−1}. This is an assigned supporting-model input used to construct a baseline measure; retain its fit and all raw components.

Source definition: Prior-year return on assets: net income (Compustat NI) for company i in year t−1 divided by average total assets for year t−1. Formula/construction: NI_{i,t−1} / average total assets_{i,t−1}. This is an assigned supporting-model input used to construct a baseline measure; retain its fit and all raw components.
